# Master Template - Next.js 16

> Production-ready Next.js 16 starter template with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, next-intl, Docker, and CI/CD.

## Available Routes
- [English Landing Page](/en): English localized landing page
- [Spanish Landing Page](/es): Spanish localized landing page
- [Health Check](/api/health): JSON health check endpoint (`{ "status": "ok" }`)
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Dynamic XML sitemap with multilingual hreflang and x-default support
- [Robots Directives](/robots.txt): Search engine crawling directives
- [Security Policy](/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 security vulnerability disclosure policy

## Technology Stack
- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs): Next.js 16 App Router, Server Actions, React Server Components
- [React Documentation](https://react.dev): React 19 core library
- [Tailwind CSS Documentation](https://tailwindcss.com): Tailwind CSS v4 design system
- [next-intl Documentation](https://next-intl.dev): Internationalization and localized routing
